comparison.objective: Refit a sprung parallel-rod pair onto four delta-robot ball studs.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanually spread a spring-loaded assembly and snap multiple cups onto studs.
comparison.success_condition: Four cups captured without drop or overstretch, followed by stable release.
comparison.reason: Elastic spreading and snap-fit assembly are materially different from pouring and mobilizing media through apertures while retaining workpieces.
